Item.Name: S_UNIT_ID
Item.Hint: Scan Unit ID or enter `M' for manual entry

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 default_value('N','GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme');
 default_value('D','GLOBAL.checkin_type');
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if :s_unit_id = 'M'
 then
 :ctrl_blk.unit_id := '';
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := '';
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := '';
 :GLOBAL.field_left := 'ctrl_blk.unit_id';
 go_block('manual_unit_entry_coexist');
 else
 NEXT_ITEM;
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 If :s_unit_id != 'M'
 then
 validate_unit_id_coexist(:ctrl_blk.s_unit_id,'S','*',temp_unit);
 check_package_failure;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_unit;
 End If;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :GLOBAL.rid_found := 'Y';
 :GLOBAL.rtu_found := 'Y';
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if :GLOBAL.rid_found = 'N' and
 :GLOBAL.rtu_found = 'N' then
 show_error('2182');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.rid_found = 'Y' then
 go_block('rid');
 execute_query;
 :s_arrow2 := '->';
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.rtu_found = 'Y' then
 :s_arrow2 := ' ';
 go_block('rtu');
 execute_query;
 :s_arrow := '->';
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_item VARCHAR2(1);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select 'X'
 into temp_item
 from remote_test_units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.rtu_found :='N';
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select 'x'
 into temp_item
 from result_inp_dtl
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk.unit_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.rid_found := 'N';
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Item.Name: S_ARROW2
Item.Hint: arrow keys to navigate, [PRVBLK] samples block.

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
begin
 select to_char(received_date,'mm-dd-yy hh24:mi') into
 :s_received_date
 from
 result_inp_hdr
 where tb_id = :tb_id;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
 begin
 select substr(code_desc,1,15)
 into :s_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'RESUL' and
 code = :result_code and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;
